insight: Building tools in tiers allows validation before scaling

title: Multi-Perspective Integration > Single Expertise
evidence: Autogarage validation: 5 experts, 3 overlaps, 1 conflict, 1 unique insight
principle: No single perspective sees whole picture. Integration of diverse expertise yields solutions ordinary approaches miss. Magic happens in synthesis, not collection.

patterns.conflicts: Innovation opportunity (resolve with win-win, not average)
patterns.unique: Blind spot discovery (domain expertise unlocks innovations)
